retention_reason_and_period.reason: Commercial record keeping, accounting evidence and resolving financial rights; preserve only necessary records
retention_reason_and_period.financial_record_anchor: Statutory relevant book completion annotation or cessation of trading as applicable; correspondence has issue/receipt anchor. Do not substitute order date.
retention_reason_and_period.legal_hold: Specific documented dispute, authority requirement or other verified duty; limited scope, reason, review date and release condition. No blanket indefinite hold.

storage_backup_expiry_policy.restore_rule: Before restored data becomes accessible, reapply completed deletions using restricted minimal deletion ledger; validate and erase restored media separately.
storage_backup_expiry_policy.completion_rule: Do not claim backup expiry or full erasure until applicable actual provider/manual-copy retention and scoped file deletion are verified.

synthetic_deletion_rehearsal_scope: Fresh profile only, minimal disposable PostgreSQL17 schema. Production transactional accounts not covered; executor disabled.
legal_identity_use: Google verification and public Play developer information authorized by owner on 2026-10-25; not in app UI or repository
personal_google_account_legal_name_displ: Google states legal name is displayed publicly on Play for personal accounts; brand name does not suppress it
identity_authorization_source: owner affirmative reply after explicit Google Play public-name question, 2026-10-25
operations_confirmation_source: owner affirmative reply to admin/support and 7-day response / 30-day processing target proposal, 2026-10-25
operator_capacity_confirmation_source: owner personal-capacity response and delegated retention decision, 2026-10-25
nonessential_account_data_policy: After identity verification, erase nonessential account data and owned media within the approved 30-day service target. Retain only specific necessary evidence, not whole accounts/chat archives. Erasure completion must reflect actual execution.
